notes: EvidenceBundle contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY. An EvidenceBundle is the complete set of EvidenceRecords relevant to one engineering decision. Every dimension retains its own state · no dimension is silently promoted.

required_fields.name: candidate_id
required_fields.shape: string · which candidate this bundle evaluates

required_fields.name: dimensions
required_fields.shape: object · one entry per dimension · each holds an evidence_id list + rolled-up state

required_fields.name: dimension_states
required_fields.shape: object · one entry per dimension · rolled-up state per evidence-state-model

required_fields.name: baseline_bundle_id
required_fields.shape: string · pointer to baseline bundle · nullable

required_fields.name: delta_summary
required_fields.shape: object · per-dimension delta between baseline and candidate

required_fields.name: unresolved_dimensions
required_fields.shape: array of dimension names still in NOT_MEASURED · BLOCKED · INCONCLUSIVE

invariants: every required_dimension has an entry · at minimum with state=NOT_MEASURED or NOT_APPLICABLE
no dimension in NOT_MEASURED is presented as PASSED to downstream consumers
overall_confidence = insufficient when any load-bearing dimension is NOT_MEASURED / BLOCKED / INCONCLUSIVE
unresolved_dimensions must be explicitly enumerated · never quietly omitted
bundle_id is monotonic and never reused
consumption_rules: NEX2 may reference specific evidence_ids in its review · never fabricate new evidence
NEX3 may reference specific evidence_ids in its arbitration · never fabricate new evidence
NEX3 verdict must cite at least one evidence_id per active criterion · uncited criteria default to insufficient
